slides.title: Stop the wedding, but make it restaurant paperwork

slides.label: Stop the wedding
slides.title: The venue's liquor license expires the day before.
slides.body: Open bar becomes a very sad lemonade stand.

slides.label: Stop the wedding
slides.title: The caterer's insurance certificate on file is from 2024.
slides.body: The venue coordinator noticed. Of course she noticed.

slides.label: Stop the wedding
slides.title: Half the kitchen's food handler cards expired in August.
slides.body: Everyone got certified the same week. Everyone forgot the same week.

slides.label: Stop the wedding
slides.title: "Who renews the health permit?"
slides.body: Three people pointing at each other. Nobody pointing at a calendar.

slides.label: Okay, resume the wedding
slides.title: Someone put every renewal date in one place.
slides.body: Save this before your busy season hits.
